decision: Close rank-935 projection of the frozen source SwiGLU output. The nonlinear source function retains passing cosine but misses RMSE only after projection, while its unprojected output passes both gates. Authorize one train-derived source-neuron contribution threshold audit behind the identical factorized attention. It must derive one neuron subset from training-only contribution statistics, evaluate that single subset held out, account physical cost, and perform no neuron-count or importance-method sweep.
claim_boundary: Negative projected source-nonlinear coefficient evidence plus positive uncompressed diagnostic only; no compressed component, installed host, runtime, autonomous, complete-model, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
